name: AcoustID verification
description: Check downloaded files against the AcoustID fingerprint database so the server keeps only the recording it asked for.

clientKey.title: AcoustID client key
clientKey.description: Application API key registered at https://acoustid.org/new-application. Register a key for this server rather than reusing a public example key.

baseUrl.title: Lookup URL
baseUrl.description: Full URL of the AcoustID lookup endpoint. Point it at a test double to keep traffic off AcoustID.

minScore.title: Minimum match score
minScore.description: Lookup results below this confidence are ignored, so a weak match cannot decide a verdict.
